title: Niveau d’Émissions de Référence des Forêts pour la Réduction des Émissions dues à la Déforestation en République Démocratique du Congo
note: January version. National deforestation level from sample based area estimates for 2000 to 2014, extrapolated linearly to 2015 to 2019. No risk map.

title: Niveau d’Émissions de Référence des Forêts pour la Réduction des Émissions dues à la Déforestation en République Démocratique du Congo
note: May modified version. Same sample based activity data and linear extrapolation of 2000 to 2014 emissions, with interpreter uncertainty analysis. No spatial allocation.

title: Report of the technical assessment of the proposed forest reference emission level of the Democratic Republic of the Congo submitted in 2018
note: Assesses the linear trend extrapolation and the reference sample interpretation, and lists areas for improvement. Deforestation only, national scale.

title: Niveau des Emissions de Référence pour les Forêts (NERF) de la République du Congo
publisher: Coordination Nationale REDD, République du Congo
note: Historical deforestation from stratified visual sample interpretation, plus an upward adjustment for planned deforestation and logging from national development plans. No risk map.

title: Niveau d’Emissions de Référence pour les Forêts (NERF) de la République du Congo
publisher: Coordination Nationale REDD, République du Congo
note: Improved April 2017 version. Sample based historical emissions with a revised adjustment for planned deforestation and planned degradation in concessions.

title: Report of the technical assessment of the proposed forest reference emission level of the Congo submitted in 2016
note: Questions the transparency and basis of the adjustment for future planned deforestation above the historical average for 2000 to 2012.

title: Niveau d’Emissions de Référence pour les Forêts (NERF) de la République du Congo
publisher: Ministère de l’Environnement, du Développement Durable et du Bassin du Congo
note: January 2024 draft of the revised submission. Its method was read only in the June 2024 version listed next.

title: Niveau d’Emissions de Référence pour les Forêts (NERF) de la République du Congo
note: June 2024 revision. A change probability model, clustered into three strata, guides sample interpretation for 2016 to 2021. Historical average plus a small adjustment.

title: Report on the technical assessment of the proposed forest reference emission level of the Congo submitted in 2024
note: Assesses the 2017 to 2021 average, the adjustment, sample point accuracy and how uncertainties were combined. Level revised downward during assessment.

title: Gabon’s Proposed National REDD+ Forest Reference Level
note: February version. Net removals level over five activities from systematic sample based forest cover change, with an upward adjustment. No risk map.

title: Gabon’s Proposed Modified National REDD+ Forest Reference Level
note: October modified version. Sample based forest loss and gain with confidence intervals, historical net removals and a ten per cent adjustment. No spatial allocation.

title: Niveau de référence forestier national REDD+ modifié proposé par le Gabon
note: French text of the October modified submission, with the same sample based method and adjustment.

title: Report on the technical assessment of the proposed forest reference level of Gabon submitted in 2021
note: Assesses the net removals level for 2000 to 2009 and comments on the basis of the ten per cent adjustment and the uncertainty reporting.

title: Presentación del Nivel de Referencia de Emisiones Forestales de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial a la UNFCCC
note: January version. Deforestation and degradation areas from stratified visual sample interpretation over a change map. National level with no risk map.

title: Presentación del Nivel de Referencia de Emisiones Forestales de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial a la UNFCCC
note: October modified version. Linear projection was considered and rejected for a recent historical average. Stratified sample estimates with error matrices by region.

title: Report on the technical assessment of the proposed forest reference emission level of Equatorial Guinea submitted in 2020
note: Assesses the historical average level, the stratified sample of interpreted points and the uncertainty of the emission estimates. No adjustment applied.

title: Niveau de référence pour les forêts du Cameroun
note: Proposes a zero reference level for 2021 to 2025 against 2000 to 2020 net removals. Land use change from interpreted sample points. No risk map.

title: VM0048 Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation
note: Version 1.0 framework. Project baselines use deforestation area allocated from jurisdictional activity data through the unplanned deforestation module.

title: VMD0055 Estimation of Emission Reductions from Avoiding Unplanned Deforestation

title: VT0007 Unplanned Deforestation Allocation (UDef-A)
note: Version 1.0. Benchmark risk map from distance to forest edge. Alternative maps must beat it on median absolute error over a confirmation period before allocation.

title: VM0015 Avoided Unplanned Deforestation
note: Version 1.2, still active. Projects the location of baseline deforestation with driver based risk maps, confirmed on a held back period by Figure of Merit.
